purpose: Rules for running Python scripts and managing dependencies with uv so that version numbers are chosen and written by uv rather than by people or AI.
summary: Scope: applies when project instructions mandate uv
Where to declare dependencies: PEP 723 inline metadata versus pyproject.toml
Run scripts with uv run, not system python3
Add and remove dependencies with uv add/remove, never hand-write versions
Locking with uv lock and uv run --locked, committing lock files
Updating dependencies with uv tree --outdated and lock --upgrade
exclude-newer = "3 days" to avoid freshly published versions
requires-python lower bound set to latest stable Python
tasks: Writing or running a Python script in a uv project
Adding or removing a script dependency
title: uv 利用ルール
